_readme: Every photo here is free to use commercially under the Unsplash License (https://unsplash.com/license). Run `npm run photos` once on your computer to download them into public/images/photos/. Until then the site shows its own illustrations. To change a picture, replace `id` with the id from any Unsplash photo URL (the part after images.unsplash.com/), or drop your own JPG into public/images/photos/ with the same key as its file name.
